title: Race and Ethnicity in Sarasota County, Florida
text:
While Sarasota County as a whole is predominantly White (around 84% overall), census tracts show distinct geographic patterns:

Black residents are concentrated in northern Sarasota near the historic Newtown community, reaching up to 74% in that tract while remaining under 2% across most other tracts.
Hispanic residents make up roughly 10% of the county and are most represented in urban Sarasota and eastern tracts towards North Port.
Asian residents make up about 2% of the county population and are evenly distributed across tracts.
